comments.body: the `has-changes` class doesn't seem to have any corresponding styles?
Can use CSS nesting here
done
I removed it.

```suggestion
					:primary-key="internalPrimaryKey!"
```
`line-height: 1;` cuts off the underlength of the typeface. I don’t think this is necessary.
It looks like this margin-top never applies.
`font-size: 12px;` can be removed because the size is inherited.
~~By removing `--v-icon-color: var(--theme--foreground-subdued)` the parent color will be applied and you also don’t need to set the hover color … (see below)~~
As described above, the `.version-icon` part here can be removed ~~if you also remove the `--v-icon-color` rule above~~.

This could be simplified by just passing the `small` prop. Then the `.version-icon` class can be removed (also in the styles below). Also, I think we should use the same icon that is used in the collection settings (`published_with_changes`).

```suggestion
						<v-icon small name="published_with_changes" />
```
The `.version-icon` class can be removed (see above).

The props `secondary` and `rounded` props can be removed. If we don’t use different styles for the button on the main version, we can remove the `.main` class here as well. Since we are using a button element here, we should add a `type="button"`.

```suggestion
				<button class="version-button" type="button" @click="toggle">
```
We can remove this `div.version-current` and put its styles into the `button.version-button` instead (see below)
As described above, this could be removed and put into `.version-button` below instead.
What does the `max-width` do here?

We could remove the `span.version-name` and apply the class `.version-name` directly to the `<v-text-overflow>` component.

```suggestion
                        <v-text-overflow
                            class="version-name">
                            :text="currentVersion ? getVersionDisplayName(currentVersion) : t('main_version')"
                            placement="bottom"
                        />
```

I would recommend adding more space between the top of the viewport and the `.headline` so that it does not stick so tightly to the top.

I would recommend adding:

```CSS
.title-container .headline { top: 3px; }
.title-container .title { top: 4px; }
```

Before:

![before](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c622eaf9-c443-49f3-a928-eec00e20aa6d)


After:

![after](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f3bced89-6a62-4c27-b57d-f306f493113b)
Is this `.version-current` in use?
I leave it up to you whether we use `small` (18px) or `font-size: 16px` … maybe the latter makes more sense.
